text: 404 | International Rice Research Institute Skip to main content Who We Are Featured Expert Shalini Gakhar Data Scientist - Interoperability and Data Science Life Cycle View Profile > About Us IRRI harnesses rice science to reduce poverty and hunger, with a focus on impact, partnership, and sustainability. IRRI Leadership Team IRRI’s Leadership Team brings together dynamic leaders from across research and corporate services, working in unison to drive the institute’s everyday operations. Board of Trustees IRRI’s Board of Trustees brings experience and insight to uphold integrity and drive mission-focused governance. Our Experts Engage with IRRI’s experts working across disciplines to advance innovative solutions. Careers Join a diverse and mission-driven team dedicated to transforming agri-food systems. Where We Work IRRI operates in diverse environments across Africa and Asia—advancing regionally tailored research with global partners. Our Work in the Regions IRRI’s transformative work spans 17 countries across Asia and Africa, where our innovations are being tested and tailored to meet the unique challenges of each region. Africa Learn about IRRI’s work with farmers, governments, and research hubs across the Eastern and Southern African regions. Southeast Asia Discover regional research programs focused on digital tools, inclusive markets, and sustainable farming in Southeast Asia. South Asia IRRI’s work in South Asia strengthens seed systems, food security, and public-private agricultural research. East Asia Explore how IRRI collaborates with China and South Korea to improve rice breeding, food systems, and youth training. What We Do Featured Project AP-NATURES: Andhra Pradesh NATURal farming and low-Emission rice Systems Read More > Our Projects IRRI’s work tackles today’s most pressing food security and climate challenges through strategic programs and global partnerships. Impact Goals IRRI delivers demand-driven solutions across three interconnected goals, ensuring measurable impact where it matters most: for people, the planet, and livelihoods. Our Solutions Combining science and innovation to deliver a portfolio of demand-driven solutions at the nexus of climate, food, and nature. News and Events Featured News IRRI, Nottingham Scientists Join Forces to Develop Rice That Can Withstand Rising Temperatures Read More > IRRI in Action Read institutional updates and project highlights across IRRI’s work in science, policy, and community partnerships. IRRI News Read institutional updates and project highlights across IRRI’s work in science, policy, and community partnerships. Events Explore IRRI-hosted events, conferences, and training programs promoting collaboration in rice science. Media Center Access press kits, downloadable materials, and contact information for media inquiries. Rice Today Rice Today is an international magazine dedicated to the world of rice which highlights the impact and importance of rice research in tackling poverty, global food security, and environmental issues. Experience IRRI Learn how to visit IRRI’s campuses or join experiential tours and learning opportunities. Resources and Services Featured Publication Rethinking rice reserves: Policy pathways for stability amid market turbulence Read More > Open Access Access IRRI’s open library of research publications, datasets, digital innovations, and technical services. Publications and Datasets Search our library of peer-reviewed studies, datasets, tools, and technical materials made available for global use. Digital Innovations Discover open-access tools, platforms, and data services driving rice science and agricultural planning. IRRI Tech Transfer Learn how we work with partners to co-develop, license, and scale rice innovations across the public and private sectors. Research Support Services Tap into IRRI’s lab capabilities and technical services to support collaborative research and diagnostics. IRRI Genebank Explore, access, and utilize high-quality data on thousands of rice accessions conserved at the International Rice Genebank Policy Briefs and White Papers Explore science-driven insights and evidence-based recommendations shaping the future of rice research, innovation, and policy. IRRI Policies IRRI's governing documents that outline expectations, responsibilities, and standards of conduct for our work and workplace.
